companionFormNamedBySourceButNotHeld.whatItIs: Notice Regarding Restricted Information Pursuant to Rule 20-201.1
companionFormNamedBySourceButNotHeld.namedBy: CC-DC-089 prints, above its first blank, that it must be filed with this request unless the filing is into one of six restricted case types. Expungement is not one of the six.
companionFormNamedBySourceButNotHeld.consequence: No MDJ-008 is bound to this family by any source record. The packet does not carry one, does not stand in for one, and names the gap in participant-instructions.md and filing-instructions.md.
